name: freecampus-course-check
description: Validate minimum Quarto course and journey structure

scripts.check:templates: node dist/index.cjs templates/course && node dist/index.cjs templates/journey
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:templates
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md action.yml package.json package-lock.json src scripts tests .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md action.yml package.json package-lock.json src scripts tests .github
